disclaimer.label: Disclaimer
disclaimer.title: Still in development
disclaimer.body: Noah Cursor is an early, actively developed CLI. Features, registry assets, and IDE support will keep expanding over time. Expect iteration — APIs, commands, and packaged Skills/Rules may change as the tool matures. Feedback is welcome while it grows.

roadmap.title: Growing next
roadmap.summary: Planned direction as the project continues — not a hard schedule.
items: More Skills, Rules, Prompts, MCP configs, and Presets in the registry
Deeper IDE coverage and smoother browse/add UX
Clearer docs and release notes as each version ships

releases.title: First public release
releases.summary: The first version decided for public use — the starting line for Noah Cursor as a product people can install and trust.
notes: Designated as the first public version for general use
Point Buy Me a Coffee links to the klnaufr support page
